messages:
amal: Quick heads-up — ran a sustained long-context (64k) profile on the streaming runtime and saw a sharp KV cache memory growth + a spike in eviction counters mid-run. Not a single noisy log, just metrics trend.
amal: Key observations:
- eviction_count per-node jumped ~3x after ~45m
- residency_pct drops from ~92% -> ~63% over the same window
- fragmentation_ratio (free_buckets / total_buckets) increased steadily
- saw repeated evict_reason=age and evict_reason=frag_compact labels

amal: PromQL snippets I used (feel free to copy):
```
sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (node)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kv_residency_bucket[10m])) by (le))
avg(kv_fragmentation_ratio) by (pool)
sum(kv_eviction_reason_count) by (reason)
```

tara: same, noticed on canary yesterday. Throughput stayed flat but p99 latency crept up ~45ms. suspect reuse of KV segments dropped so more recompute.

josh: can we add these to the runtime perf dashboard? suggested panels:
- per-model kv_hit_rate (by tenant/model)
- kv_residency percentiles (p50/p95/p99)
- eviction_rate heatmap by node
- fragmentation_ratio trend and bucket-level histograms

mike: +1 for eviction_reason label breakdown. also want a per-request trace sample when eviction_count spikes — get maps of token position -> cache miss.

amal: I pushed a quick metrics PR with new labels: evict_reason, pool, model_id. PR: https://git.redwood/infr/kv-metrics/pull/314 (will link logs soon)

ci-kv-bot: build #314 passed on bench nodes (3/3). deploy to staging queued.

josh: proposal for short-term mitigations:
- increase soft residency threshold by 10% for long-context flag
- enable compacting sweeps more aggressively when fragmentation_ratio > 0.25
- throttle optimistic prefetching during sustained 1M token windows

tara: long-term: we should add a KV sampler that captures a tiny provenance blob for evicted entries (model, seq_pos, last_used_ts) so we can correlate reuse loss to workload patterns.

mike: alerting suggestion: firing if (sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[10m])) by (cluster) > 100 and avg(kv_residency[10m]) < 70%) for 10m. low-noise but catches bad ramps.

amal: I'll add dashboards and bind an alert runbook. assigning: amal -> dashboard panels + runbook, josh -> metric panels + labels, tara -> sampling PR, mike -> alert definition. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial dashboard.

josh: noted. I'll also look for any kernel-selection interactions — sometimes certain qkv kernels increase transient mem pressure that worsens fragmentation.

amal: thanks. I will post the flamegraph + jemalloc stats once staging finishes. :coffee:
